profile.name: Binder MK 56 气候试验箱
profile.description: 这是一台实验室气候试验箱，用于在受控箱体环境中对样品进行温度相关的稳定性测试、环境模拟和常规培养/存放实验。设备通过箱门装载样品，并可查看运行模式与箱门状态。
profile.description_en: This is a laboratory climate chamber used to expose samples to a controlled chamber environment for temperature-related stability testing, environmental simulation, and routine incubation or storage experiments. Samples are loaded through the chamber door, and the device provides operating-mode and door-status information.

registry.name: BINDER GmbH Binder MK 56 climate chamber
registry.description: Binder Mk56是由BINDER GmbH生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括打开、温度设置。支持Signal, Slot, get mode等操作。
